title: a16z Podcast: Shifting Risk Mindsets, From Tech to Bio

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: What challenges do first-time founders or tech founders encounter when building companies in the bio space.
reader_summary.overview: What challenges do first-time founders or tech founders encounter when building companies in the bio space, and how do they differ from traditional tech companies? In this hallway-style conversation episode of the a16z Podcast (originally recorded as a video), a16z bio team general partners Vijay Pande and Jorge Conde.

key_points.text: In this hallway-style conversation episode of the a16z Podcast (originally recorded as a video), a16z bio team general partners Vijay Pande and Jorge Conde.
They cover everything from different paths to market and different partnerships (including pharma) to different timelines and milestones for validating the product and business itself..
But how do we get to a common language that bridges the worlds of tech and bio?
